header.title: How to Extend a Portable Dishwasher Hose
header.description: This guide explains how to extend the drain and water hoses of a portable dishwasher using couplers and clamps. Follow these steps to safely lengthen your dishwasher's hoses for improved placement flexibility.

steps.description: This step instructs the user to visit a hardware store to purchase necessary tools and materials for the dishwasher repair.
actions: Find a hardware store with a large plumbing department.
Note the dimensions of your hoses or remove them.
Purchase a hose in the desired length for each of the two hoses on the back of the dishwasher.
Determine coupler and clamp sizes using the hoses.

steps.description: This step involves attaching a coupler between the dishwasher hose and an extension hose using a metal clamp.
actions: Slide the metal clamp on to the hose
Insert the coupler into the exposed end of the original hose
Insert the other end of the coupler into the extension hose

steps.description: Position the adjustable metal clamps on the hose, ensuring they sit on top of the coupler, and then tighten them to secure the connection.
actions: Move the clamps up the length of the hose
Position the clamp on top of the coupler
Lightly tug on the hose to make sure that it is secure
Repeat steps 2 and 3 for the second hose

steps.description: Test the dishwasher's functionality with the new hose extensions by attaching them and running a short cycle.
actions: Roll the dishwasher to the desired position
Attach the hoses to the faucet adapter
Insert everything as with the original hoses
Run a short cycle to test the extensions
